question: Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. U has an exam on Saturday. Only four people have an exam between T and S, neither of whom has an exam on Monday. V has an exam immediately after P and Q has an exam immediately before P. S has an exam after V. How many people have exams after T?
solution:
Given: Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week.

 
• U has an exam on Saturday.
 
• Only four people have an exam between T and S, neither of whom has an exam on Monday.
 
• V has an exam immediately after P, and Q has an exam immediately before P.
 
• S has an exam after V
